author: (Ravenel, 1861)

note.en: A small, smooth, oval cockle of about 1.6 cm that burrows in sand. It is known here from one museum specimen taken at 12 m off the Cahuita reef.
note.es: Un berberecho pequeño, liso y ovalado de unos 1,6 cm que se entierra en la arena. Aquí se conoce por un ejemplar de museo tomado a 12 m fuera del arrecife de Cahuita.

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen(s) in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001), 3 km NE of Cahuita outside the reef

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection and other museum records), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: INBio specimen 3 km NE of Cahuita, 2001.
